metadata.name: DPINeuron
metadata.author: Indiveri, G.; Stefanini, F.; Chicca, E.
metadata.description: Current-mode DPI adaptive integrate-and-fire circuit — full coupled membrane, positive-feedback, and spike-triggered adaptation equations

dynamics.i_mem: 0.0 if refractory_time > 0.0 else (i_mem / (tau * i_tau)) * ((i_rest + I) / (1.0 + i_mem / i_g) - i_tau + exp((log(i_0) + kappa * log(i_mem)) / (kappa + 1.0)) * sigmoid(alpha * (i_mem - i_threshold)) - i_ahp)
dynamics.i_ahp: (i_ahp / (tau_ahp * i_tau_ahp)) * ((i_spike if refractory_time > 0.0 else 0.0) / (1.0 + i_ahp / i_ga) - i_tau_ahp)
dynamics.refractory_time: ((-refractory_time / dt) if refractory_time < dt else -1.0) if refractory_time > 0.0 else 0.0

extensions.spike_pulse: During refractory_time > 0, i_mem is held at i_reset and i_spike drives the adaptation DPI.
extensions.event_order: Simultaneous explicit-Euler state update, post-update threshold detection, then reset and refractory-pulse start.
extensions.dt_contract: The parameter dt mirrors integration.dt so the refractory timer reaches zero exactly on the final pulse step.
extensions.maintained_boundary: Normalised parameters, I_in=i_rest+I, explicit Euler, sampled level detection, and the discrete refractory counter are maintained SC-NeuroCore choices rather than values or a recurrence printed by the paper.
extensions.nonclaims: No transistor mismatch, measured chip timing or power, PPA, device, board, HIL, physical-silicon, or universal formal-equivalence claim.
